rules_enforced: No retraining until data acquired and validated

critical_classes.source_name: Kaggle / PlantVillage Bell Pepper Leaf Spots
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Cercospora capsici causes frogeye leaf spot in bell pepper. Exact biological pathogen match.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify foliar lesions exhibit distinct circular grey/white centers with dark brown borders.
critical_classes.notes: Ensure no overlap with Pepper Bacterial Spot.

critical_classes.source_name: Zenodo / Brassica Foliar Disease Collection (Mycosphaerella brassicicola)
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Exact mycological identity (Mycosphaerella brassicicola ring spot on Brassica oleracea).
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify ring patterns containing tiny black speck fruiting bodies within concentric rings.
critical_classes.notes: Do not confuse with Broccoli Alternaria or Downy Mildew.

critical_classes.source_name: Roboflow Universe / Brassica Alternaria Benchmark
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Alternaria brassicae / brassicicola on cauliflower leaves. Exact visual and biological match.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Inspect for concentric target-board dark brown zonate foliar lesions.
critical_classes.notes: Exclude cabbage cross-folds if unlabeled.

critical_classes.source_name: ICAR-IARI Vegetable Pathology Archive
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Soft rot caused by Pectobacterium carotovorum on curd and petiole tissue.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Confirm presence of water-soaked macerated foliar or curd tissue with brown discoloration.
critical_classes.notes: Exclude dry physiological rot.

critical_classes.source_name: WSU Tree Fruit Extension Pathology Database
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Podosphaera clandestina powdery mildew on Prunus avium foliage.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify white superficial powdery mycelial coating on leaf lamina and terminal shoots.
critical_classes.notes: Exclude cherry leaf spot.

critical_classes.source_name: Embrapa Coffee Research Repository / Roitman Collection
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Pellicularia koleroga (Koleroga noxia) black rot on Coffea arabica foliage.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Confirm blackening of leaves suspended by web-like hyphal threads.
critical_classes.notes: Do not map coffee berry disease.

critical_classes.source_name: Mendeley Data / Coffee Leaf Disease Dataset (Bravos et al.)
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Cercospora coffeicola brown eye spot. Exact pathogen match.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify circular brown lesions with light grey center and bright chlorotic halo.
critical_classes.notes: Distinct from Coffee Leaf Rust.

critical_classes.source_name: UC Davis IPM Tree Fruit Pathology Database
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Tranzschelia discolor on Prunus persica leaves. Exact botanical/pathological identity.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Inspect for bright yellow angular spots on upper surface and rusty brown pustules on lower leaf surface.
critical_classes.notes: Do not confuse with Peach Leaf Curl.

critical_classes.source_name: Penn State Extension Stone Fruit Disease Archive
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Xanthomonas arboricola pv. pruni causing shot-hole angular leaf spots on plum.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify small angular purple-black spots that drop out creating shot-hole effect.
critical_classes.notes: Do not confuse with Plum Pox Virus.

critical_classes.source_name: INRAE Stone Fruit Pathology Repository
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Tranzschelia pruni-spinosae rust on plum leaves.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify yellowish specks on adaxial leaf surface with dark brown uredinial clusters on abaxial surface.
critical_classes.notes: Isolate from Plum Pocket.

critical_classes.source_name: Cornell Fruit Pathology Caneberry Diagnostic Library
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Sphaerulina rubi (Mycosphaerella rubi) leaf spot on Rubus idaeus.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify circular lesions with dark red-purple margins and white-gray centers.
critical_classes.notes: Do not map Raspberry Fire Blight or Gray Mold.

critical_classes.source_name: Kaggle / Brassica Disease Identification Dataset
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Alternaria brassicicola on Brassica oleracea var. capitata.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Inspect for concentric rings with chlorotic yellow halo on cabbage leaves.
critical_classes.notes: Separate from Cabbage Black Rot.

critical_classes.source_name: University of Minnesota Extension Fruit Diseases
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Taphrina communis / pruni hypertrophy on plum fruit and foliage.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Confirm presence of enlarged spongy distorted fruit pockets and deformed shoot leaves.
critical_classes.notes: Exclude Plum Brown Rot.

critical_classes.source_name: NC State Tobacco Pathology Extension Archive
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Cercospora nicotianae frogeye leaf spot on Nicotiana tabacum.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Inspect for round tan spots with thin brown border resembling frog eye.
critical_classes.notes: Do not map Tobacco Brown Spot or Blue Mold.

critical_classes.source_name: ICAR-IISR (Indian Institute of Spices Research) Ginger Pathology
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Rhizoctonia solani on Zingiber officinale pseudostem and leaf sheath.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Confirm oval water-soaked lesions with dark brown borders on lower pseudostem sheath.
critical_classes.notes: Do not harvest generic rice sheath blight frames; require ginger canopy context.

critical_classes.source_name: CIAT (International Center for Tropical Agriculture) Bean Pathology
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Bean Common Mosaic Virus (BCMV) on Phaseolus vulgaris.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify foliar mosaic pattern with dark green blistering and downward leaf curling.
critical_classes.notes: Exclude soybean mosaic images.

critical_classes.source_name: Bioversity International Banana Pathology Collection
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Cordana musae / Neocordana musae on Musa acuminata.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify large oval zonate necrotic lesions with bright yellow halo along leaf margins.
critical_classes.notes: Do not confuse with Black Sigatoka (Black Leaf Streak).

critical_classes.source_name: Texas A&M AgriLife Cucurbit Pathology Database
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Pseudoperonospora cubensis downy mildew on Cucurbita pepo var. cylindrica.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Inspect for angular chlorotic yellow lesions bound by veins on upper surface, purplish-gray sporulation beneath.
critical_classes.notes: Separate from Cucurbit Powdery Mildew.

critical_classes.source_name: PlantVillage / Kaggle Tomato Benchmark
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Septoria lycopersici on Solanum lycopersicum.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Verify circular brown spots with tiny black pycnidia embedded in light center.
critical_classes.notes: Essential for resolving confusion with Tomato Bacterial Leaf Spot.

critical_classes.source_name: Cornell Vegetable MD Online Cucurbit Collection
critical_classes.decision_rationale: Podosphaera xanthii powdery mildew on Cucurbita moschata / maxima.
critical_classes.verification_requirement: Confirm white talcum-like powdery fungal growth across upper squash leaf lamina.
critical_classes.notes: Do not harvest generic cucumber powdery mildew frames without squash leaf morphology.

rejected_sources.source_name: Kaggle Generic Plant Disease Augmentation Dumps
rejected_sources.reason_for_rejection: Artificial geometric/noise augmentations of existing PlantVillage images without original raw capture metadata.
rejected_sources.risk: Data duplication, test-set leakage, distortion of genuine lesion pathology.

rejected_sources.source_name: Generic 'Leaf Blight' / 'Leaf Spot' Unlabeled GitHub Repos
rejected_sources.reason_for_rejection: Lacks biological pathogen taxonomy (e.g. labeling mixed fields as 'leaf spot' without specifying crop or pathogen species).
rejected_sources.risk: Semantic pollution and corrupting crop-specific disease classifiers.

rejected_sources.source_name: Stock Photo Aggregators (Shutterstock, Getty, iStock web crawls)
rejected_sources.reason_for_rejection: Non-botanical decorative photos, post-processed filters, heavy color grading, and non-scientific visual guessing.
rejected_sources.risk: Domain shift and false positive artifacts in production.

rejected_sources.reason_for_rejection: Lacks leaf-level resolution required for EfficientNet-B2 macro diagnostic pathology.
rejected_sources.risk: Sub-pixel lesions and canopy blur degrading classifier attention.
